definitionZh: @ counter-style CSS at- rule 允许您扩展预定义的列表样式,并定义不属于预定义的一组样式的自己的计数器样式. @ counter-tyle 规则包含描述符,定义了如何将计数转换成字符串表示.
sourceDefinition: The @counter-style CSS at-rule lets you extend predefined list styles and define your own counter styles that are not part of the predefined set of styles. The @counter-style rule contains descriptors defining how the counter value is converted into a string representation.
